about_the_game:
The game is set in the early 16th century within the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine)—a frontier region where rules are yet to be written and danger can strike without warning.

Bygoner is being developed by a solo developer from Ukraine.

Key Features:

  • A personal, atmospheric journey: A focused "journey-game" without an open world.

  • Non-linear progression: A forward-only structure where every step counts.

  • Curated experience: Compact locations and narrative-driven events instead of aimless wandering.

  • Grim world-building: Dark, cynical stories and difficult choices with no "right" answers.

  • Fragmented structure: Designed to be accessible for both short bursts and long gaming sessions.

  • Tactical combat: Inspired by HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts), seeking a balance between speed, risk, and control.

Development Roadmap:

  • 2023 – Development begins

  • 2025 – Steam page launch

  • Early 2026 – Demo release

  • Late 2026 – Early Access launch

  • 2026–2028 – Early Access support and updates

  • 2028 – Full Release*

    *Dates and stages are subject to change during development.

❓ FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions

  • What does the title “Bygoner” mean?The word is fictional and inspired by the phrase “let bygones be bygones.” It combines “bygone” (the past) and “goner” (someone doomed or as good as dead). The idea reflects the protagonist’s state — he must either overcome his past or be consumed by it. For now, he exists somewhere in between.

  • Is this an open-world game?
    No. Bygoner is a focused journey-game featuring compact locations and forward-only movement.

  • Does the game feature a "living world" with many NPCs?
    No. The game focuses on specific events, distinct characters, and narrative novellas rather than a simulated living world.

  • Is this a AAA RPG (like Assassin’s Creed or Kingdom Come)?
    No. Bygoner is an auteur indie game focused on atmosphere, player choice, and the feeling of a journey rather than massive scale.

  • How long is a typical play session?
    The game is designed to accommodate both short sessions (10–20 minutes) and longer playthroughs.

  • Are there choices and consequences?
    Yes. Your decisions affect the course of events, the locations you visit, and the state of your journey—but don't expect a clear-cut "correct" choice.

  • Is this an action game?
    Combat is a vital part of the experience, but it serves to support the narrative and the journey, not replace them.

  • Can I backtrack on the map?
    No. By design, the only way is forward.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12400 or Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Bygoner is a compact, nonlinear medieval journey. Dark, cynical stories, dynamic encounters, and focused gameplay push you forward with no way back. A nameless knight travels through the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.
supported_languages:
English*, Ukrainian, German, Polish
*languages with full audio support
